desc: Implement `count_up_to(n)` with digit DP over position, tight flag, started flag, digit sum, and digit product.
Handle leading zeros so they do not contribute to digit sum or digit product, and exclude the all-zero number.
Collapse any state where a zero digit has appeared after the number has started to `digit_product = 0`, and count it as beautiful at the end if `digit_sum > 0`.
At the end of the DP, count a number only if it has started and `digit_product % digit_sum == 0`.
Run the current solution against the provided examples and edge cases and report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
